steps.content: Hella stands atop a jutting rock, an Aurum Secretum cannon on her shoulder aimed directly at the Apostle of Ashes.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Hella?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey Hypa! How ya holding up? I'm back to help you kick some monsters' asses!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: How did you...?! Hasn't everyone already retreated? Where are the others now? Don't tell me they also...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No! The barrier has already failed! I-I can't protect you on my own. You need to leave now!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Easy! You think the top fighter of Syndicate who's busted through Black Rings would sweat a small battle like this?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: As for the Furorians... Hehe, don't worry. They've all run far, far away by now. Nobody needed convincing this time. They couldn't leave fast enough!
The cannon transforms into a heavy bludgeon in Hella's hands as she swings it with full force, sending a sand beast approaching from the side flying through the air.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hypatia is fighting the Apostle to protect Furor, and she's in grave danger! The lab staff stole all the Aurum Secretum, but we can't just run away like cowards! Come on, let's catch up to them! We have to help our Lady Campbell...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I've learned a ton on my little adventure this time! A good lie needs to be mixed in with some truth. Uh, an old friend from WhiteSands taught me that. She's not the most trustworthy person per se, but her tricks sure work! See? Just put it to good use, didn't I?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't worry! Everyone's in a safe place now. Once we finish this fight, we'll go meet up with them together!
She pats the Aurum Secretum device at her side, then turns her attention back to the Apostle.
[Small CG - Confrontation A]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Mira

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What kind of loser picks on a girl all on her own? If you've got any guts, come out and face my cannon like a real fighter!
The gale infused with Mania fails to knock her down. Hella stands tall, her eyes gleaming with determination.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But... it's too dangerous. This was only ever my responsibility... You shouldn't have to...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh stop that now!
[Small CG - Confrontation B]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We all feel we're not strong enough sometimes, that all we do is make mistakes, and we're scared to death when we're all alone. Happens to everyone, and that's okay!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That old friend from WhiteSands taught me another thing as well: You should grow a thicker skin and stop guilt-tripping yourself all the time. It never should have been a choice between sacrificing one person or a hundred...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Here's a Syndican trick: If you can't win a fight alone, get more guys to back you up! If one person can't finish a job, get everyone to help! If we put all 101 brains together, we can definitely think of a new solution!
[Small CG - Confrontation C]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So, I'll help you out and hit where you miss!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If you still feel guilty about it, just promise me you'll try your hardest. Come back alive and thank us later!
[Small CG - Confrontation D]

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: It's not that simple...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But... is that true? So... you all still want to see me...
If there are still people waiting for her, then she cannot let them down.
[Background - City Center - Day]

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I have a plan. It's very risky... I couldn't have managed it before, but now, you're by my side.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Hella, will you help me?
Hella leaps down from above and seizes Hypatia's hand.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You bet I will!
[Scene Change] [Background - Downtown - Day]
Streets lie in ruins as the Apostle circles in the sky above Furor. The Sinner has suddenly masked her presence. The Apostle can no longer find its target.
As the wind dies down, the Apostle hesitates, ready to leave—until a flying stick catches its attention.
Hey! You big coward over there, watch this!
The tiny Sinner stands in the middle of the street, somehow emanating the presence of a one-person army ready to hold the line.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Aren't you hungry? Don't you want a midnight snack? Aren't you tired of hiding in the storm like a loser all the time?
Hella holds up an object high in the air. A crooked, almost disfigured tiny Aurum Secretum doll.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If you want it, come and get it yourself!
Activated by Mania, the doll erupts with tremendous energy.

steps.speaker: Apostle of Ashes
steps.content: ...!
Black sand takes on a solid form and chases after the girl. Hella runs at full speed, heading toward the rendezvous point Hypatia told her about just ahead...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...But you never told me this thing could run so faaaaaaast!
She trips over something. Right behind her, the Apostle lunges forward aggressively, but the Sinner dodges out of the way with a quick roll.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Hella, get in!
Horo reaches out and pulls Hella into the vehicle. The Legion's thoroughly battered car speeds away, racing toward the final battleground.
[Background - Underground Experiment Site- Dim]
Hypatia enters the underground facility and sees a blue-haired woman standing beside a metal device.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Have they all left?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Yes...

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: ...I see. You look way more at ease now, compared to before.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: I'm leaving too. There's nothing left here that I need. Whatever remains is yours.
The blue-haired woman turns and leaves without hesitation. Once again, Hypatia is left alone in the place.
The utter silence here is almost eerie. The Apostle's roars cannot penetrate this deep underground. Sunlight will never grace this subterranean space.

She used to hate this place. The future seemed much like the dark crypt before her, devoid of any light. Just like Furor's black sand-shrouded sky which only a faint glimmer of light could shine through at noon.
But...
Hypatia breathes deeply, feeling the pulsations beneath her palm. The Aurum Secretum hums and vibrates in resonance, like another person's heartbeat pressed against her side.
[Enter Flashback] [Background - Downtown - Day]

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I will activate the underground mechanisms. That place is the core facility for Apostle research equipped with the most advanced Aurum Secretum instruments. It's also our last hope to defeat it.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But while I do that, someone has to lure the Apostle to a strategic position. The problem is, I've run out of Aurum Secretum...

Hypatia watches in surprise as Hella rummages through her pockets and pours out a jumble of small items. Various Aurum Secretum parts salvaged from the Furorians' gear. Numerous small pieces eventually form a decent pile.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: When they heard I was coming back to help you, they shoved all the usable materials they had into my pockets. Think this is enough?
Hypatia's surprise melts into a genuine smile as she accepts the Aurum Secretum.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: It's not the purest, but it should suffice. Aurum Secretum can temporarily amplify the resonance with the user's Mania. It'll serve as a moving target to the Apostle, which makes the perfect bait.
Her voice trails off, her hand still resting upon Hella's. Hella looks up questioningly, noticing the conflicted expression on Hypatia's face.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I can't guarantee this plan will succeed. Acting as bait will be extremely dangerous. Hella...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Do you trust me?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Seems like the genius of the Campbell family doesn't know everything after all.
Hypatia looks up, meeting Hella's bright eyes.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You had my trust from the beginning, dummy.
[CG - Final Showdown A]

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Furor was always shrouded by dark clouds. People couldn't see the light, so they mistook me for the sun. But I cannot save them, and the Campbell family never should have been their hope.
At some point, her hands have stopped trembling.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hypa, now's your chance...!
The crystal shivers in her hand. Hypatia touches it, and then...
[CG - Final Showdown B]
Immense energy erupts from the crystal and surges through Hypatia's fingertips, converging into a beam of light that pierces straight through the ground at the Apostle!

All the Aurum Secretum is simmering with power for Hypatia, and in this moment, the whole Furor answers her call. This is her final battle, where she will reclaim with her own hands the radiance that was once stolen from the Furorians.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Now, it's time to take back what's ours!
